title: Injectivity conjecture for discrete homotopy and homology of the graphs $G_n$
statement:
Let $G_1$ be a cycle graph of length $5$, and let $G_n$ be the graphs defined recursively in the source via the discrete suspension construction. For each $n$, let $\psi:A_n(G_n)\to \hc_n(G_n)$ be the natural homomorphism from discrete homotopy to discrete singular cubical homology. **Injectivity conjecture for $G_n$.** The map $\psi$ is injective for all $n$.

The theorem preceding this conjecture establishes surjectivity in the relevant family, so injectivity would make $\psi$ an isomorphism for every $n$. The conjecture is motivated by the analogy between $G_n$ and the sphere $S^n$.
source_name: Bob Lutz, “Higher discrete homotopy groups of graphs”, arXiv:2003.02390 (2020).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.02390

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2020).
